verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
In Your presence
All fear is gone
In Your presence
In Your presence
Is where I belong
In Your presence

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Father I am waiting
I need to hear from You
To know that You're approving
Of what I say and do

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
'Cause nothing really satisfies
Like when You speak my name
So tell me that You'll never leave
And everything will be okay
